content_sections.heading: RMLAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the RMLAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download RMLAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualifications as per UGC/AICTE Regulations/PCI Guidelines. Temporary basis up to the end of academic session 2025-26 or maximum up to 11 months, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RMLAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Candidates are required to report for the walk-in interview with the prescribed application form and self-attested set of academic and supporting documents. Original documents must be brought for verification. The application form must be enclosed with a demand draft of Rs.500/- (Five Hundred Only) drawn in favour of Finance Officer, Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University, Ayodhya payable at Faizabad, Ayodhya. Candidates should ensure they are eligible for the post. Report at Shri Ram Singh Shalabh, Bhawan Infront of Mahatma Gandhi Examination Building, Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University, Ayodhya on 22-09-2026 at 10:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Faculty/Instructor posts at RMLAU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies announced for Guest Faculty/Instructor positions at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Avadh University Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q3. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the basic eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty/Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as per UGC/AICTE Regulations/PCI Guidelines, with a minimum qualification of graduate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RMLAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- (Five Hundred Only) for all categories, payable via demand draft.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the appointment for these posts?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a temporary basis up to the end of the academic session 2025-26 or a maximum of 11 months, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Shri Ram Singh Shalabh, Bhawan Infront of Mahatma Gandhi Examination Building, Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University, Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the prescribed application form, self-attested academic and supporting documents, and original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit mentioned for these posts?
faq.answer: The specific age limit details are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Avadh University Ayodhya?
faq.answer: The official website of the university is www.rmlau.ac.in.
